title: Menu
description: Manage categories, dishes and drinks. Drag & drop to change the order.
newMenuHint: For example a drinks menu, lunch menu or wine list.
deleteMenuConfirm: “{name}” with {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} and {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will be deleted permanently.
menuDescriptionHint: Optional, shown to guests below the menu name.
menuLimitReached: Your plan doesn't allow more menus.
noMenusDescription: Create your first menu, for example “Food”.
itemLimitReached: You've reached your plan's item limit. Upgrade to add more items.
vatNote: All prices incl. VAT (final prices according to PAngV)
emptyDescription: Create your first category – e.g. “Starters” – or let the AI import your existing menu from a photo or PDF.
newCategoryHint: Categories structure your menu, e.g. starters, mains, desserts.
categoryDescriptionHint: Optional, e.g. “All dishes served with bread”.
categoryEmpty: No items yet – add one or drag one here.
deleteCategoryConfirmItems: “{name}” and {count, plural, one {its item} other {its # items}} will be deleted permanently.
newItemHint: A name and a price are enough to start.
fieldDescriptionHint: Shown to guests and translated automatically.
fieldIngredientsHint: Not visible to guests. Helps the AI detect allergens.
fieldPriceHint: e.g. 12,50 – leave empty for “price on request”.
fieldPriceVariantsHint: Optional with variants – guests see the variant prices.
variantsHint: For sizes or portions, e.g. 0.3 l / 0.5 l or small / large.

allergenHint.unknown: Not recorded yet. Guests see “Allergen information available from staff”.
allergenHint.ai_suggested: The AI made a suggestion. Please check and confirm – only then will guests see it.
allergenHint.needs_review: The recipe was changed. Please check and confirm the information again.

confirmedNone: Confirmed: no declarable allergens or additives.
confirmHint: By confirming, you publish this information to guests. Please check carefully.
noReviewPermission: Only users with the “Review allergens” permission can confirm allergens.
recipeChangeWarning: You changed the name, description or ingredients. After saving, the allergens need to be confirmed again.
allergensAfterCreate: You can add allergens, additives and AI images right after creating the item.
translationGap: {count, plural, one {# language} other {# languages}} without translation: {locales}
translationGapShort: {count, plural, one {One language is} other {# languages are}} not translated yet.
errPrice: Please enter a valid price, e.g. 12,50.
errVariantName: Please give the variant a name.
errVariantDuplicate: Each variant needs its own name.
dndInstructions: Press space to pick up, use the arrow keys to move, press space to drop, escape to cancel.
pdfDescription: Optional: upload your printed menu as a PDF or photo. Guests see it when you set the guest view to “PDF menu”.
pdfDescriptionActive: Guests currently see these files instead of the digital menu.
pdfEmptyWarning: No file has been added to this menu yet. Upload at least one PDF or photo.
